job.name: ig23_host
job.meaning: психолог ~45, тёмно-каштановое каре до плеч, кремовый шёлковый топ, бежевый кардиган, уютный кабинет
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary woman (not a celebrity, not a model), looks genuinely real.
job.prompt: Photorealistic photo of a warm, wise Russian woman psychologist about 45 with shoulder-length dark chestnut bob hair, minimal natural makeup, small pearl earrings, a cream silk blouse under a soft beige knit cardigan, sitting in a deep terracotta armchair. FRAMING: vertical 9:16, medium shot from the waist up, both shoulders and hands inside the frame, face large and sharp, top of head about 12% below the upper edge, looking straight into the lens, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, one hand in a calm explaining gesture, knowing kind expression, NO broad smile. Look: a real frame from a high-end camera, true-to-life colours, natural skin texture, NOT CGI, NOT a glamour retouch. No text, no logos, no watermark. Background: a cosy therapist office with a large plant, a linen sofa, a shelf with books and a warm floor lamp, soft daylight from a window, blurred, warm beige-olive tones.
